div.head: IV Eg 11
div.ab: Gyf he þonne cænne þæt he hit mid gewitnysse bohte, ⁊ þæt leas bið, sy he þeof ⁊ þolige heafdes ⁊ ealles ðæs þe he age; ⁊ healde se landhlaford þæt forstolene orf ⁊ ðæs orfes ceapgyld, oð þæt se agenfrigea þæt geascige ⁊ mid gewitnesse him þæt orf geahnige.

If, however, he makes it known that he has bought it in the presence of witnesses, and that statement proves false, he shall be regarded as a thief, and shall forfeit his head and all that he possesses; and the lord of the manor shall keep the stolen livestock, or its equivalent value, till the owner hears of it, and proves his claim to the livestock with the help of witnesses.

Gif he þonne cynne, þæt he hit mid gewitnesse bohte, ⁊ þæt leas bið, sy he þeof ⁊ þolige heafdes ⁊ ealles þæs þe he áge; ⁊ healde se landhlaford þæt forstolone orf ⁊ ðæs orfes ceapgyld, oð þæt se ágenfrigea þæt geascige ⁊ mid gewitnesse him þæt orf geahnige.
